Namur

Sunday 27 December 2026

The iconic Citadel of Namur will host the UCI Cyclo-cross World Cup on Sunday 27 December. Steep gradients, cobbled sections and the infamous off-camber make this cyclo-cross race one of the toughest on the calendar. Last year, Lucinda Brand and Mathieu van der Poel triumphed. Who will follow in their footsteps at the Citadelcross?

Tickets

Would you like to join us in Namur on Sunday 27 December? Click the button below and order your tickets now!

Ticket prices:

Presale: €20.50 (service fee included)

On race day, both at the on-site ticket office and online: €25 (service fee included)

Children born in 2014 or later can enter for free and do not need a ticket.

 

[GO TO THE TICKET SHOP](https://namur.tickets.ucicyclocrossworldcup.com/selection?language=en)

Practical information

Address

Website local organisation

Visit the website of the local organisation [here](https://cyclocrossnamur.be/en/).

 

Heb je een vraag?

Contacteer de organisatie [hier](https://www.ucicyclocrossworldcup.com/nl/contact).

How to get there?

By bike

A bicycle parking area is available near the Thonard roundabout. Be sure to bring a bike lock.

 

By bus

Take bus line 3 (Namur La Plante – Namur Citadelle) and get off at the Namur Citadelle rond-point Thonard stop. More information [here](https://www.letec.be/lines/N2030?date=2026-07-17T00:28:00.465Z&direction=La%20Plante).

 

By train

From Namur railway station, it's about a 40-minute walk to the course.

 

By car

Parking is available on Avenue du Milieu du Monde.
